author: Patrick Cc:
description:
Nobody wants to criticize or address the uncomfortable truth surrounding Tiger Woods' countless controversies. Because of the discipline he has shown on the golf course and the legacy that came with it, his personal life spiraled in ways that would have destroyed anyone else's reputation. But the world of golf and his fans literally can not hold him accountable. Which almost certainly means he will never change.
